mao.desc: Mao Zedong: round face, receding hairline with short black hair at the sides and back, the famous mole on the chin, gentle closed-mouth smile; gray-green Zhongshan suit with four front pockets and five buttons, matching trousers, black blocky shoes

joey.desc: a fair-skinned man in his late 30s with a big messy mop of loose ringlet curls, dark brown with lots of silver-gray on top, a scruffy dark-brown beard, very large round translucent amber tortoiseshell glasses, a thin silver chain necklace, an oversized boxy off-white t-shirt with a chest pocket, loose faded light-blue straight-leg jeans to the ankles, and black woven leather fisherman sandals with bare feet

thomas.desc: a fair-skinned man in his late 30s with a big soft voluminous tousled mop of dark-brown hair with a swept fringe, light ginger-brown stubble, blue-gray eyes, a slight half-smile, a white long-sleeve crew-neck t-shirt with a dark wristwatch on the left wrist, dark slim trousers and simple dark sneakers

lincoln.desc: Abraham Lincoln: tall gaunt face with deep-set eyes, dark chin-curtain beard with no mustache, tall black stovepipe hat, long black frock coat over a black waistcoat, white shirt with a black bow tie, black trousers and black boots

obama.desc: Barack Obama: short close-cropped black hair graying at the temples, clean-shaven, warm smile, big ears, charcoal suit jacket over a crisp white shirt with a blue tie, an American flag lapel pin, dark trousers and black dress shoes

queen.desc: Queen Elizabeth II is an elderly woman of petite, sturdy build, featuring a round, fair-skinned face with soft wrinkles, gentle blue eyes, and a closed mouth with light pink lipstick, framed by short, voluminous curled white hair beneath a solid lilac wide-brimmed hat with a flower, wearing a solid lilac knee-length coat dress with a silver brooch on the lapel, a white pearl necklace, empty hands in solid white gloves, sheer beige tights, and low-heeled solid black dress shoes
